from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash balance reported in a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the document belongs to")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of cash reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the number (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="Date or period end the balance is as of")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
